title: Chancellor
name: Smt. JAYASHREE MOHTA
quote: Heir to a glorious tradition of learning and scholarship, India today is modern, young and focused on reinventing itself to take its rightful place among the comity of nations. Demographically speaking, every second Indian is less than 25 years of age today. The vast energy of such a youthful nation is finding creative outlets in all fields - be it education, business, entrepreneurship, defence, sports, governance etc.
content: This is the context in which we have to view education in our country. There is an insatiable thirst for knowledge, skills and entrepreneurship among the youth of India, as witnessed in the explosion of under-graduate and post-graduate courses, especially professional. Their needs can be satisfied only by quality educational institutions with requisite standards in every respect. Delivering anything less will be unjust and unfair to the aspirations of thousands of young hopefuls. We are acutely conscious of our responsibilities in this regard and have been striving to render quality education with values. It will be our prime concern to ensure that at SBU, Ranchi students find complete self-expression in the ambience of the university. We aspire to render every help to make their dreams come true. It gives me great pleasure to commend SBU to the youth of India!
headerTitle: From the Desk of Honorable Chancellor

title: Pro-Chancellor
name: Sri B.K. Dalan
quote: It is a matter of great pride and privilege for me and for those, who are associated with this outstanding institution since its beginning, having a dream to impart the state of the art of education to one and all. I feel honoured that I am a part of the institution in name and style of the ‘Sarala Birla University' which is a part and parcel of the “Birla Legacy.
content: The hallmark of an ideal educational institution is to provide quality education. Our mission consist of a series of enhancements each raising the individual to a higher level of awareness, understanding and kinship leading to wholesome development of an individual and thereby contribute to the productive development of the state and the country. We, at the University, continuously aspire to be a procreation ground for positive ideas and emerge as a symbol of openness of thoughts, cultural integrity and celebrating the state of being secular. We prefer to opt for a journey by inculcating discretion, efficiency, creativity and determination to work for the betterment of the society. While we are all strongly committed and determined to explore all the avenues for maximum placement, we expect students to be passionate about their dreams and make their family and society proud of their achievements.
headerTitle: From the Desk of Honorable Pro-Chancellor

title: Vice-Chancellor
name: Prof. (Dr.) Jeganathan Chockalingam
quote: As I assume the position of Vice-Chancellor, I feel privileged to lead an institution that symbolizes knowledge and progressive education. Sarala Birla University (SBU), Ranchi, uniquely combines traditional values with modern aspirations.
content: Our commitment to provide a multidisciplinary education is reflected in our wide array of programs, that includes engineering, business management, humanities, law, and health sciences. We take pride in promoting not only intellectual growth but also character development, ensuring our students emerge as responsible and socially aware leaders of the future. As we progress, SBU remains committed to achieve global educational standards. Our collaborations with leading institutions, emphasis on experiential learning, and focus on research excellence equip our students to navigate the challenges of a rapidly evolving world. Simultaneously, our community is anchored in the values of empathy, integrity, and respect for diversity. In the upcoming months, we plan to enhance our academic offerings and campus facilities to enrich the experience for every student. Whether you are studying engineering, law, management, humanities, or any of our other distinguished faculties, you are part of a supportive and dynamic environment designed to help you reach your full potential. Let us continue to pursue excellence in all our endeavors, fostering a spirit of inquiry and a passion for learning. We eagerly anticipate collaborating with all of you to ensure that Sarala Birla University remains a leader in transformative education.
headerTitle: From the Desk of Honorable Vice-Chancellor

title: Registrar
name: Prof S. B. Dandin
quote: There is no end to education. It is not that you read a book, pass an examination, and finish with education. The whole of life, from the moment you are born to the moment you die, is a process of learning.
content: A famous saying by Jiddu Krishnamurti, SBU exactly believes on it and intends to establish an institute to empower global learning environment. The prime focus of the examination department would be 'Students', to make them capable enough to face the competitive world through quality education and develop moral value systems. I would like to utilize my experience, knowledge and expertise to fulfil the vision to make 'Sarala Birla University' Unique. Emphasis is given to improve skills of learning and wholesome personality development. The core strength of the University is proposed to be commitment towards developing research capacity and professional programmes in the proposed domains. University offers courses in the discipline of Engineering, Commerce, Management, Humanities, Yoga, Computer Application and Applied Sciences. It would be a challenging journey for us and so we look forward for all the unconditional support from well wishers, parents, students and our management. University will always be a learner centric institute, committed to excellent teaching, research and always dedicated for social work. Last but not the least; I would like to allude the great thought of Swami Vivekananda "Education is the manifestation of the perfection already in man.

title: Director General
name: Prof. Gopal Pathak
quote:
"आ नो भद्राः क्रतवो यन्तु विश्वतः"
(Let noble thoughts come to us from every side)
content: Sarala Birla University, Ranchi epitomizes this Rigvedic hymn as I see a distinct vibrancy characterizing its functioning. Despite its glorious legacy and a trusted brand image in the field of education, SBU exhibits a zest similar to a young pupil, willing to learn and grow every day. This persistent striving for high academic standard assures me of the brighter future of the university. In its pursuance of global standards of excellence, Sarala Birla University offers a platform where students are not only imparted curriculum-based education, but are also provided exposure to national and international developments in the academia and the industry. Instead of mere fact- feeding, our pedagogical methods aim to bring out the best from the students by fuelling their calibre with creativity and craftsmanship. As the Director General, I particularly take pride in the fact that with all its zeal for innovation, SBU remarkably remains rooted to tradition by holistically developing the skills and conscience of the students based on the Indian value system. Students must feel proud of Social, Ethical and Moral values of our system. Sarala Birla University promotes a culture of learning where knowledge is accompanied by prudence, research and creativity are supported by strong academic integrity and personal development comes with a sense of social responsibility. As SBU seeks to establish strong liaison between the academia, industry and the business sector, I hope we reinvent education with all patience and perseverance, and make this young institution a national pride.
headerTitle: From the Desk of Honorable Director General
